leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Define a TypeScript interface to represent pagination state with properties for current page, items per page, and total items.
Implement React state hooks to store and update pagination data within a component.
Apply arithmetic operations to calculate the total number of pages based on total items and items per page.
Use array methods to slice data arrays and display only the items for the current page.
Construct reusable UI components to display pagination controls with page numbers.
Handle click events on pagination buttons to update the current page state.
Execute conditional rendering to disable navigation buttons when on the first or last page.
Utilize useEffect hooks to fetch or update data when the current page changes.
Control component behavior by implementing logic to prevent invalid page numbers.
Return structured JSX that combines data display with interactive pagination controls.
Access and display page metadata (e.g., 'Page X of Y') using computed pagination values.
Modify pagination parameters (items per page) and observe how the UI and calculations update.
